arguments.summary: Fixed `ranges/merge.py`: the merge condition used strict overlap (`start < last_end`), so touching intervals like (1,3) and (3,5) weren't merged — changed it to `start <= last_end` per the documented closed-interval behaviour. Also added `sorted(intervals)` before merging so unsorted input is handle...
